path.title: Path
path.description: The path under which this endpoint serves the HTTP requests, for proxy use 'proxy'

consumes.title: Consumes
consumes.description: The content type this endpoint accepts as an input, such as application/xml or application/json. null or */* mean no restriction.

cookieDomain.title: Cookie Domain
cookieDomain.description: Sets which server can receive cookies.

cookieHttpOnly.title: Cookie Http Only
cookieHttpOnly.description: Sets whether to prevent client side scripts from accessing created cookies.

cookieMaxAge.title: Cookie Max Age
cookieMaxAge.description: Sets the maximum cookie age in seconds.

cookiePath.title: Cookie Path
cookiePath.description: Sets the URL path that must exist in the requested URL in order to send the Cookie.

cookieSameSite.title: Cookie Same Site
cookieSameSite.description: Sets whether to prevent the browser from sending cookies along with cross-site requests.

cookieSecure.title: Cookie Secure
cookieSecure.description: Sets whether the cookie is only sent to the server with an encrypted request over HTTPS.

handleWriteResponseError.title: Handle Write Response Error
handleWriteResponseError.description: When Camel is complete processing the message, and the HTTP server is writing response. This option controls whether Camel should catch any failure during writing response and store this on the Exchange, which allows onCompletion/UnitOfWork to regard the Exchange as failed and have access to the caused exception from the HTTP server.

httpMethodRestrict.title: Http Method Restrict
httpMethodRestrict.description: A comma separated list of HTTP methods to serve, e.g. GET,POST . If no methods are specified, all methods will be served.

matchOnUriPrefix.title: Match On Uri Prefix
matchOnUriPrefix.description: Whether or not the consumer should try to find a target consumer by matching the URI prefix if no exact match is found.

muteException.title: Mute Exception
muteException.description: If enabled and an Exchange failed processing on the consumer side the response's body won't contain the exception's stack trace.

populateBodyWithForm.title: Populate Body With Form
populateBodyWithForm.description: Whether to populate the message Body with a Map containing application/x-www-form-urlencoded form properties.

produces.title: Produces
produces.description: The content type this endpoint produces, such as application/xml or application/json.

requestTimeout.title: Request Timeout
requestTimeout.description: The period in milliseconds after which the request should be timed out.

returnHttpRequestHeaders.title: Return Http Request Headers
returnHttpRequestHeaders.description: Whether to include HTTP request headers (Accept, User-Agent, etc.) into HTTP response produced by this endpoint.

useBodyHandler.title: Use Body Handler
useBodyHandler.description: Whether to use BodyHandler for the request. If set to false then the request will no be read and parsed.

useCookieHandler.title: Use Cookie Handler
useCookieHandler.description: Whether to enable the Cookie Handler that allows Cookie addition, expiry, and retrieval (currently only supported by camel-platform-http-vertx)

useStreaming.title: Use Streaming
useStreaming.description: Whether to use streaming for large requests and responses (currently only supported by camel-platform-http-vertx)

bridgeErrorHandler.title: Bridge Error Handler
bridgeErrorHandler.description: Allows for bridging the consumer to the Camel routing Error Handler, which mean any exceptions (if possible) occurred while the Camel consumer is trying to pickup incoming messages, or the likes, will now be processed as a message and handled by the routing Error Handler. Important: This is only possible if the 3rd party component allows Camel to be alerted if an exception was thrown. Some components handle this internally only, and therefore bridgeErrorHandler is not possible. In other situations we may improve the Camel component to hook into the 3rd party component and make this possible for future releases. By default the consumer will use the org.apache.camel.spi.ExceptionHandler to deal with exceptions, that will be logged at WARN or ERROR level and ignored.

exceptionHandler.title: Exception Handler
exceptionHandler.description: To let the consumer use a custom ExceptionHandler. Notice if the option bridgeErrorHandler is enabled then this option is not in use. By default the consumer will deal with exceptions, that will be logged at WARN or ERROR level and ignored.

exchangePattern.title: Exchange Pattern
exchangePattern.description: Sets the exchange pattern when the consumer creates an exchange.

fileNameExtWhitelist.title: File Name Ext Whitelist
fileNameExtWhitelist.description: A comma or whitespace separated list of file extensions. Uploads having these extensions will be stored locally. Null value or asterisk () will allow all files.

headerFilterStrategy.title: Header Filter Strategy
headerFilterStrategy.description: To use a custom HeaderFilterStrategy to filter headers to and from Camel message.

platformHttpEngine.title: Platform Http Engine
platformHttpEngine.description: An HTTP Server engine implementation to serve the requests of this endpoint.
